title: New Shell Integration PowerToy: Copy as UNC
author: RamblingGeekUK
summary: The current upstream head needs changes before merge. The shell command has reliability and path-classification defects, sparse-package registration resolves external binaries from the wrong directory, the Windows/GPO/settings integration is incomplete, clean-build metadata is inconsistent, and the core behavior lacks focused automated coverage. The upstream branch also currently conflicts with main.

proposed_comments.title: Make path resolution and clipboard writes reliable

confidence.rationale: The current handler can terminate its COM host on allocation failure, reports success after resolution or clipboard failures, leaks the global allocation when SetClipboardData fails, and treats local device paths beginning with two backslashes as UNC paths.

proposed_comments.body:
### Make path resolution and clipboard writes reliable

**Severity:** `high`

`CopyAsUNCContextMenu/dllmain.cpp` currently performs allocating work inside a `noexcept` COM entry point without an exception boundary, returns `S_OK` after resolution or clipboard failures, and does not free the global allocation when `SetClipboardData` fails. Its two-backslash test also accepts local device namespaces such as `\\?\C:\...` and `\\.\C:\...` as UNC paths. Please add an exception-to-HRESULT boundary and RAII/explicit cleanup, propagate meaningful failures, distinguish normal and extended UNC paths from local device paths, and keep the `ERROR_MORE_DATA` retry bounded.

proposed_comments.title: Register the sparse package against the installation root

confidence.rationale: The module DLL is emitted under WinUI3Apps, while the manifest resolves PowerToys.exe and WinUI3Apps/PowerToys.CopyAsUNCContextMenu.dll relative to ExternalLocationUri.

proposed_comments.body:
### Register the sparse package against the installation root

**Severity:** `high`

`CopyAsUNCExt/PowerToysModule.cpp` passes the module's `WinUI3Apps` directory as the sparse package external location, but `AppxManifest.xml` authors `PowerToys.exe` and `WinUI3Apps\PowerToys.CopyAsUNCContextMenu.dll` relative to the installation root. This resolves both paths incorrectly and prevents COM activation. Keep the MSIX URI under the module directory, but pass its parent installation directory as `ExternalLocationUri`.

proposed_comments.title: Align platform gating, settings navigation, and the supported menu model

confidence.rationale: The implementation registers only a Windows 11 IExplorerCommand, exposes the setting on unsupported systems, emits an unmapped settings route, and stores an extended-menu-only option without a classic handler where that command could appear.

proposed_comments.body:
### Align platform gating, settings navigation, and the supported menu model

**Severity:** `high`

The module has no Windows 10 `IContextMenu` fallback, so the Settings card and module availability need to be explicitly gated to Windows 11. The runner's `CopyAsUNC` settings route also needs to map to `PowerPreviewPage`; otherwise opening module settings falls back to Dashboard. Finally, remove the `bool_show_extended_menu` setting and its hide condition unless a classic extended-menu handler is implemented, because the current modern-only command disappears completely when that option is enabled.

proposed_comments.title: Complete GPO, build, signing, and installation integration

confidence.rationale: The current head reads a policy that is absent from the shipped ADMX/ADML templates, leaves the settings control interactive under policy, imports a WIL version different from packages.config, and omits required package versioning and installation-verification coverage.

proposed_comments.body:
### Complete GPO, build, signing, and installation integration

**Severity:** `high`

Add the Copy as UNC policy to `PowerToys.admx` and `en-US/PowerToys.adml`, and disable the Settings toggle while that policy controls the value. Make the WIL import and `EnsureNuGetPackageBuildImports` use the version restored by `packages.config`, add deterministic `-NoProfile` resource-generation commands, ensure the MSIX is versioned and signed through the existing pipelines, and include the new DLLs/MSIX in installation verification.

proposed_comments.title: Add focused coverage and trim the repository-wide allowlist change

confidence.rationale: The current head has no automated coverage for the utility's path-resolution/clipboard contract, and its spell-check change adds roughly 450 unrelated entries, including misspellings, to a repository-wide allowlist.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add focused coverage and trim the repository-wide allowlist change

**Severity:** `high`

Please add focused tests for direct UNC input, mapped-drive resolution, `ERROR_MORE_DATA`, local/device-path rejection, resolution failures, clipboard handoff/failures, settings serialization, and GPO-controlled state. Also reduce `.github/actions/spell-check/expect.txt` to only the Copy as UNC identifiers that genuinely need exemptions; the current repository-wide expansion suppresses unrelated spelling findings.
